title: Decision
description: Schema for a decision made during a meeting.

meetingId.description: The ID of the meeting this decision belongs to.

criterio.description: The criteria used to make the decision.

ownerId.description: The ID of the participant who owns the decision.

impacto.description: The potential impact of the decision.

hashPrev.description: The hash of the previous item in the decision's blockchain (see Bloque 10).

hashSelf.description: The hash of this decision object (see Bloque 10).
